datasource.template.hint: Lay the rows out in your own markup. Print a value with a token such as [{'@'} rows[0].column {'@'}], repeat an element with v-for="row in rows", choose with v-if and v-else, put a token inside an attribute such as class="badge [{'@'} row.status {'@'}]", and format values with the number, percent, currency, date, dateTime, round, truncate, upper, lower, default and join filters, written after a pipe symbol. Names are not case sensitive. Only safe tags are allowed and every value is escaped. Use row['column name'] for names with spaces.
